# utils

`exception.cpp`, `resources.cpp`, `scheduler.cpp`, and `scheduler.hpp` implement Windows crash handling, resource interception, and callback scheduling for Project: Consolation.

## Contents

- [exception.cpp](./exception.cpp) — `exception::component` installs `exception_filter`, writes minidumps, redirects crashed x86 contexts, and terminates the process after `display_error_dialog()`.
- [resources.cpp](./resources.cpp) — `resources::component` hooks `LoadIconA` and `LoadImageA`, manages `icon`, `logo`, and `splash`, and redirects resource loading.
- [scheduler.cpp](./scheduler.cpp) — `schedule`, `loop`, `once`, and `on_shutdown` manage asynchronous, main-frame, and renderer callback pipelines.
- [scheduler.hpp](./scheduler.hpp) — `scheduler::pipeline`, `cond_continue`, `cond_end`, and scheduler callback declarations define the scheduling API.

## Architecture / Data Flow

`exception::component::post_load()` installs `exception_filter`, which evaluates `is_harmless_error()`, invokes `write_minidump()`, stores `exception_data`, redirects `ContextRecord->Eip`, and reaches `reset_state()` before `display_error_dialog()`.

`resources::component::post_start()` loads `icon`, `splash`, and `logo`, while `resources::component::load_import()` routes `LoadIconA` and `LoadImageA` through `load_icon_a()` and `load_image_a()`.

`schedule()` creates `task` instances in `pipelines[type]`; `task_pipeline::merge_callbacks()` transfers `new_callbacks_` into `callbacks_`; `task_pipeline::execute()` invokes eligible handlers; `once()` removes completed tasks through `cond_end`.

## Patterns

`REGISTER_COMPONENT(exception::component)`, `REGISTER_COMPONENT(resources::component)`, and `REGISTER_COMPONENT(scheduler::component)` connect component lifecycles to the loader.

`scheduler::loop()` uses `cond_continue`, while `scheduler::once()` uses `cond_end` to control task retention.

## Behavioral Contracts

- `is_harmless_error()` continues `STATUS_INTEGER_OVERFLOW`, `STATUS_FLOAT_OVERFLOW`, and `STATUS_SINGLE_STEP`.
- `get_reset_state_stub()` assembles `sub esp, 0x10`, `or esp, 0x8`, and a jump to `reset_state`.
- `write_minidump()` writes `minidumps/consolation-crash-%s.dmp` using `utils::string::get_timestamp()`.
- `display_error_dialog()` formats `Fatal error (0x%08X) at 0x%p.\nA minidump has been written.\n\n`.
- `display_error_dialog()` displays `"Project: Consolation ERROR"` and terminates with `exception_data.code`.
- `generate_crash_info()` emits CRLF lines containing `OS Version: %u.%u`.
- `load_icon_a()` returns `icon` for resource ID `2`.
- `load_image_a()` returns `logo` for `"logo.bmp"` and `splash` for resource ID `0x64`.
- `component::post_load()` installs scheduler hooks at `0x103C1050`, `game::game_offset(0x103F7470)`, and `game::game_offset(0x101AB0B0)`.
- `game_window_closed()` treats an invalid window lasting longer than `3` seconds as shutdown.
- `kill` terminates the `"Async Scheduler"` thread, and async execution polls `game_window_closed()` every `10ms`.

## Lifecycle

`exception::component::post_load()` establishes process-wide handling through `SetUnhandledExceptionFilter`.

`resources::component::~component()` destroys `icon`, `logo`, and `splash`.

`scheduler::component::post_start()` creates the `"Async Scheduler"` thread, `scheduler::component::post_load()` installs frame and shutdown hooks, and `scheduler::component::pre_destroy()` sets `kill` and joins `thread`.
